mentions.name: Decentralized Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) orchestration layer
mentions.description: This service treats aerial robotics as a simple API endpoint: users submit a JSON payload with geocoordinates and mission requirements (e.g., 4K video capture or infrared photos), and the backend handles fleet logistics, selecting the optimal VTOL units from distributed sub-stations based on battery state-of-charge and proximity.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building a decentralized Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) orchestration layer that treats aerial robotics as a simple API endpoint.

The system allows users to submit a JSON payload containing geocoordinates and mission requirements (e.g., capture_type: "4K_video" | "IR_photo"), the backend then handles the fleet logistics, selecting the optimal VTOL units from distributed sub-stations based on battery state-of-charge and proximity.
